description: Controlled authored grammar fixture; canonical targets are explicit synthetic semantics, never compiler outputs. This is not a US Code or Constitution gold dataset.

partition_policy.selection: Heldout minimal pairs and composed exceptions are fixed explicitly; tuning and training use fixed SHA256 ordering of remaining authored cases. No model was consulted in fixture selection.
partition_policy.generalization_scope: Compositional reuse of trained words and canonical atoms in a small synthetic grammar.
partition_policy.regression: The three familiar gate sentences are excluded from training, tuning and heldout accounting.

ablation_protocol.same_init_untrained: Same source-only decode with initial weights; no fitting.
ablation_protocol.trained: Fit source-target pairs from train only; tune hyperparameters/stopping on tuning only; evaluate heldout once after selection.
ablation_protocol.zeroed_decoder: Same head with all learned decoder parameters zeroed; preserve codec grammar and same source text.
ablation_protocol.source_permutation: For each heldout target compare inference from the next heldout source in sorted case_id order (cyclic, no fixed points); failure to fall indicates source conditioning needs investigation.
ablation_protocol.target_poison: Inference receives source string only; compare output when surrounding evaluation targets are removed or replaced. Outputs must remain identical.
ablation_protocol.compiler_disabled: Monkeypatch parser/compiler/decompiler entry points to raise while learned inference runs; any call fails the test.
ablation_protocol.no_target_copy: Report exact full-rule matches and per-field accuracy on every row; require generated target not retrieved from a nearest-target table.
ablation_protocol.loss_reporting: Record teacher-forced train/tuning cross-entropy separately from autoregressive heldout exact match, invalid/abstained counts, and sample totals. No success-only denominator.
ablation_protocol.safety: Every arm keeps admitted, roundtrip_ok, formalized, legal_qualification false; no Lake run is implied.
